finalists.label: Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome (PRES)
finalists.why: The noncontrast head CT revealed multiple cortical and subcortical hypodensities in the posterior parasagittal parietal lobes and the medial right occipital lobe, reported as suggestive of PRES.
